about: Ticket 580: silhouette cells of each cargo_hold look on hull.cargo, on a 4 mm grid, outside the rig at rest at tiers 1, 3, and by which the tier-1 rig's silhouette changes with the look in place of its own t1-hopper; written by check_outline.py. `outsideRig` must be all zero; the base look's `changesRigOutline` must be zero.
